description.p: A writing checker for spelling, grammar, punctuation, wording, clarity and tone. About twenty rules check as you type, with the spelling dictionaries of your system, and an in-depth review by a local AI model (llama.cpp with a GGUF model you choose) runs on demand, paragraph by paragraph.

Writing goals (variety of English, formality, audience and domain) steer both the rules and the AI. Plain text and Markdown documents open in tabs; Word, OpenDocument and RTF files can be imported. Nothing ever leaves your computer: the app has no network access and sees only the files you choose.
